task.name: getephemtable
task.shortdescription: Query the JPL-Horizons database for ephemeris data and create a CASA table
task.description: This task retrieves the ephemeris data of a specific ephemeris object by sending a query to JPL's Horizons system and creates the ephemeris data stored in a CASA table format.

param.name: objectname
param.description:
Name of ephemeris object. The common name of major bodies such as planets will be converted into the (NAIF/SPK) ID. If the parameter, asis is set to True, no such check or conversion will be performed before sending a query to the database. Default: none
Example: objectname='Titan' objectname='606'

param.name: asis
param.shortdescription: A toggle for objectnamne check to be done or not
param.description:
A toggle for objectname check to be done or not. asis=True will override any checks on objectname and the name has to be recongnized by the JPL-Horzions system.
Default: False
Set asis=True to specify an ojbect such as a comet by a designated name

param.name: timerange
param.shortdescription: time range of ephemeris data to be queried
param.description:
Time range of ephemeris data to be queried. Default: none
Standard CASA timerange specification(‘T0~T1’),YY/MM/DD/hh:mm, or by Modified Julian date or Juliandate if the string isi prefixedi byi ‘MJD’or‘JD’.
Examples: timerange = '2023/09/01/20:45~2023/09/02/04:00' (Note: Both start and end times need to be fully specified starting with YYYY but hours or minutes can be omitted as long as the start and stop times are distinguishable. The omitted hours or minutes are translated as '00') timerange = ‘MJD 60175.1~60176.1'

param.name: interval
param.shortdescription: Interval or step size of ephemeris data
param.description:
Interval or step size of ephemeris data Default: '1d'
Example:
interval='1h' interval='15m'

param.name: outfile
param.description:
Output CASA table name Default: none
Example: outfile = 'Titan_MJD60175.1-60176.1.tab'

param.name: rawdatafile
param.shortdescription: Name of raw ephemeris data file (optional)
param.description:
Name of raw ephemeris data file before converting into a CASA table (optinal) Default: '' = No raw ephemeris dta is saved
Example: rawdatafile='Titan-jplhorizons.dat'
